mapper.insert: insert into operation_log (userId, userName, operation, target, createTime) values (#{userId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{operatorName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{operationType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{targetName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{operateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: select log.logId, log.userId, log.userName, log.operation, log.target, log.createTime, (select isAdmin from user where user.userId = log.userId) as operatorRole from operation_log log order by log.createTime desc limit #{begin}, #{size}
